comparison.objective: Safely replace a control cassette supplied by independent mains and backup feeds; candidate commissions a mechanical shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Verify live state, isolate two feeds, prove dead, remove/install a cassette, close a guard, and restore power versus loosen-adjust-relock fine mechanics and tune from impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Cassette replaced with the bus proven below 1 V and supplies restored only after hands clear versus two safe non-bottoming stops within energy, velocity, force, rebound, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Safe service sequencing and guarded control use overlap generically, but cassette replacement and damper tuning test different physical abilities.
